items.prompt: A man's hand holding an old paper photograph with a bent corner up against the narrow glowing slit of a rift in a November forest; the photo shows a dark-haired woman, blurred and indistinct, and the light of the slit shines through the paper from behind.

alt.ru: Рука мужчины держит старую фотографию с загнутым уголком перед узкой светящейся щелью в ноябрьском лесу; на снимке размытая темноволосая женщина, свет щели просвечивает бумагу.
alt.en: A man's hand holding an old photo with a bent corner before a narrow glowing slit in a November forest; on it a blurred dark-haired woman, the light shining through the paper.
alt.pt: A mão de um homem segura uma foto antiga de canto dobrado diante de uma fenda luminosa numa floresta de novembro; nela uma mulher de cabelo escuro desfocada, a luz a atravessar o papel.
alt.es: La mano de un hombre sostiene una foto antigua con la esquina doblada ante una estrecha grieta luminosa en un bosque de noviembre; en ella una mujer de pelo oscuro borrosa, la luz atravesando el papel.

items.prompt: The shabby institute lab again: the quantum computer cryostat hangs in the centre, and a woman in a checked shirt sits at three monitors with her back to the door; a man stands in the doorway with his coat still on, looking at her.

alt.ru: Снова облезлая институтская лаборатория: в центре висит криостат, женщина в клетчатой рубашке сидит спиной к двери у трёх мониторов, в дверях в пальто стоит мужчина и смотрит на неё.
alt.en: The shabby institute lab again: the cryostat in the centre, a woman in a checked shirt at three monitors with her back to the door, a man in his coat standing in the doorway.
alt.pt: O laboratório degradado do instituto outra vez: o criostato ao centro, uma mulher de camisa xadrez de costas para a porta diante de três monitores, um homem de casaco à porta.
alt.es: Otra vez el destartalado laboratorio del instituto: el criostato en el centro, una mujer con camisa de cuadros de espaldas a la puerta ante tres monitores, un hombre con abrigo en el umbral.

items.prompt: A small one-room flat at night: a man lies on his back on a bed in the dark, eyes open, the window showing the lattice of the Shukhov tower faintly lit; the narrow hallway with its empty coat rack visible through the open door.

alt.ru: Однокомнатная квартира ночью: мужчина лежит на спине в темноте с открытыми глазами, в окне слабо подсвеченная решётка Шуховской башни, в открытую дверь видна прихожая с пустой вешалкой.
alt.en: A one-room flat at night: a man lies on his back in the dark, eyes open, the Shukhov tower's lattice faintly lit in the window, the hallway with an empty coat rack through the open door.
alt.pt: Um apartamento de um quarto à noite: um homem deitado de costas no escuro, olhos abertos, a treliça da torre Chukhov ténue na janela, o corredor com um cabide vazio pela porta aberta.
alt.es: Un piso de una habitación de noche: un hombre tumbado boca arriba a oscuras, con los ojos abiertos, la celosía de la torre Shújov tenue en la ventana, el pasillo con un perchero vacío por la puerta abierta.
